dedication.subtitle: One discipline. Two paths. A lifetime of resolve.
dedication.growth: At each confirmed level-up: gain hit points and +1 to one attribute (maximum 20).
dedication.foundation: Choose one Fighting Style and three weapon masteries at character creation.

sections.title: The shared discipline
sections.intro: Automatic calling abilities. Each has its own use per short rest.

sections.title: Exemplar · combat manoeuvres
sections.intro: Choose three at level 3; optionally learn one more at levels 7 and 9. Each costs 1 Resolve.

sections.title: Oath · sworn gifts
sections.intro: Both are granted at level 3. Damage and healing draw from the same Resolve pool.

sections.title: Oath · auras
sections.intro: Choose one at level 3. The other auras remain alternatives, not additional grants.

sections.title: Oath · vows
sections.intro: Optionally learn one at levels 5, 7 and 9. Conviction is a passive vow.

sections.title: Exemplar · the marks of mastery
sections.intro: Automatic gifts of the Exemplar path.

sections.title: Your fighting style
sections.intro: Choose one at character creation to define your approach to arms.

sections.title: Beyond the battlefield
sections.intro: Optional practice choices at levels 4, 6 and 8. These are shared across callings.

milestones.name: Extra Attack
milestones.description: A second attack with the Attack action is an authored class milestone; it is not yet available in combat.

milestones.name: Action Surge · second use
milestones.description: A second use per short rest is an authored capstone; it is not yet available in combat.
